passive.name: Headshot
passive.description: Every few basic attacks, or against a target she has trapped or netted, Caitlyn will fire a headshot dealing bonus damage that scales with her critical strike chance. On trapped or netted targets, Caitlyn's Headshot attack range is doubled.
passive.coverageNote: Basic attacks advance a cycle, while trapped and netted targets create separate ready states. The source is assigned to the attack-cycle family, but a complete reviewed binding has not been compiled yet.

spells.description: Caitlyn sets a trap that Roots the first champion that steps on it for seconds and granting True Sight of them for 3 seconds.
